notes: Imperfective verb (perfective: 'wspiąć się'). Usually followed by the preposition 'na' + accusative (e.g., 'wspinać się na górę / na drzewo').
Contrast with 'wchodzić' (to walk up/go up), which is used for everyday things like stairs or hills.
